CHIEF COMPLAINT
Status post mitral valve repair follow-up.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Patient is a 63-year-old female presenting for follow-up evaluation following mitral valve repair performed on 8/3/2020. At previous follow-up on 9/17/2020, patient was doing well from a cardiac standpoint. Patient reports feeling better since surgery, though she continues to experience intermittent chest pain and shallow breathing with exertion. These symptoms last only a few minutes and resolve with activity modification. Episodes occur approximately a couple of times per month, with symptom-free intervals lasting a couple of weeks. Patient has learned to slow down when symptoms occur and is able to resume activities afterwards. She denies new symptoms otherwise. Patient reports good medication compliance using a reminder app.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Patient denies new symptoms. Continues to experience intermittent chest pain and shallow breathing with exertion, which resolve with rest and activity modification.
